sections.title: Overview
sections.text: Cimarron engineers combustion and emissions-control equipment for oil & gas — flares, combustors and vapor recovery. We bring that equipment, and the engineering to integrate it, to plants and terminals in Bangladesh where safe disposal of relief and waste gas is a permit and safety requirement.

items.title: Enclosed & ground flares
items.text: Smokeless, radiation-controlled combustion with the flame shielded from view — for sites with strict visibility or thermal-radiation limits.

items.title: Elevated flares
items.text: Utility and emergency flare stacks sized for peak relief loads, with reliable ignition and flame monitoring.

items.title: Vapor recovery units
items.text: Recover hydrocarbon vapors from tanks and loading instead of flaring them — cutting emissions and recovering product.

items.title: Combustors
items.text: Enclosed combustors for continuous low-volume waste-gas streams where destruction efficiency must be demonstrable.

sections.title: What we deliver with it
items: Skid integration with the plant control system

sections.title: Safe disposal, on the record
sections.subtitle: Flaring and vapor control are safety barriers and permit conditions, not afterthoughts.
paragraphs: A correctly sized, reliably ignited flare protects the plant during upset and relief events; vapor recovery keeps routine emissions within limits. We engineer the package into the wider facility so the controls, interlocks and documentation line up with the rest of the plant.

sections.title: Let's discuss your next project
sections.text: Tell us what you are planning. An engineer will reply, not a sales queue.
